messages:
emma-support: FYI customer LumenCare opened a dispute — invoice 2026-02-28 shows 1,240,112 tokens billed but their dashboard (reporting) shows ~620k after dedupe. They want a refund + provisional credit. ticket INC-8912 :eyes:

sophie-support: Copy. escalating to finance. can you include any sample usage events? i'll note provisional credit request in the case. :+1:

emma-support: attaching snippet from LumenCare support case (pasted from their engineer):
```
[2026-02-28T03:12:05Z] sdk=v2.1 client_id=lum-42 embed_batch_id=eid_88a recv=200 tokens=312056 event_id=evt_aa
[2026-02-28T03:12:05Z] sdk=v2.1 client_id=lum-42 embed_batch_id=eid_88a recv=200 tokens=312056 event_id=evt_ab
```
They say the two events look identical and happened within 10ms of each other.

jasper-finance: I pulled the ledger. invoice 2026-02-28 shows tokens_total=1,240,112. The platform produced two usage events for the same embed_batch_id for this customer. looks like a double-count. preliminary suggested provisional credit = 620,056 tokens (50%). marking case INC-8912. sending ledger refs: ledger_tx_98321, ledger_tx_98322. :memo:

liam-eng: probable cause: SDK v2.1 streaming embeddings + client-side retry produced duplicate callbacks when network flapped and server returned 408 quickly. dedupe key was missing in one code path. I can reproduce with the following quick repro: enable streaming, drop ACKs, trigger retry. PR #452 adds dedupe key (embed_batch_id + request_nonce) to usage events.

billing-bot: provisional_credit_created id=pc_7782 amount_tokens=620056 reason="billing_dispute LumenCare INC-8912" created_by=jasper-finance

sophie-support: Thanks. Finance requested a revrec memo so revenue can be deferred until investigation closes. jasper-finance, can you add wording for accounting / GL?

jasper-finance: Draft revrec memo: "Defer recognition for invoice 2026-02-28 (LumenCare) for disputed 620,056 tokens pending reconciliation. Move amount from Revenue (4100) to Deferred Revenue (2100) until dispute resolved. Approval required: CFO, RevOps. Reference ledger_tx_98321, ledger_tx_98322, provisional_credit pc_7782." uploading to SF case 004512 now.

natalie-ops: I'll run a scan to find other customers affected by SDK v2.1 duplicates. running query: 
```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS billed_tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN duplicated_flag THEN -tokens ELSE 0 END) AS potential_overbill
FROM usage_events
WHERE sdk_version = '2.1' AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING potential_overbill > 100000;
```

natalie-ops: quick results — 7 customers above 100k potential overbill; 2 customers > 500k. i'm opening support tickets and tagging finance.

emma-support: LumenCare accepted provisional credit while we finalize the refund. told them SLA 72h for final answer. i'll update INC-8912 with accts contact and refund timeline. :white_check_mark:

jasper-finance: Credit processed in billing system and recorded. Revrec memo uploaded to Finance Drive and attached to SF 004512. status=under-review. once eng confirms patch deployed and we run full reconciliation, we'll issue final refund journal and close case.

liam-eng: patch merged to main, rolling out canary now. I'll post canary metrics and a follow-up script to re-run dedupe check after 24h.

sophie-support: great work everyone. linking all tickets (INC-8912, SF-004512, ENG-452) so QA can close once reconciliation completes.

emma-support: closing loop here — customer notified and provisional credit visible on their account. will update when final refund entry posts. :lock_with_ink_pen:
